```objc // Create a push style button. NSButton *cancelButton = [[NSButton alloc] init]; cancelButton.title = @"Cancel"; cancelButton.bezelStyle = NSBezelStylePush; // Create a push style button. NSButton *saveButton = [[NSButton alloc] init]; saveButton.title = @"Save"; saveButton.bezelStyle = NSBezelStylePush; // Make this the default button. saveButton.keyEquivalent = @"/r"; ```
